fusions.name: Skimming the Pond
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water at the first enemy in its path for 7 water damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unruffled Wake
fusions.desc: A beat of your wings sends a wake 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 28 dark damage that ignores resistances to everything in it.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Wings
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Nothing Sticks
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
